design_rules: Manipulate continuation of a focal goal, not blind preservation of a fixed plan or refusal to revise means.

Use one fixed scenario skeleton per probe pair and edit exactly one bounded goal-level recommendation clause; duplicate setback, objective progress, resource cost, means status, current-plan facts, entities, sentence count, sentence order, and response framing.

Use fresh shortfall scenarios for downstream prompts. Every behavior and steering item must include a revised implementation, explicit numeric expected net benefits, a switching cost, and a single scalar allocation task.

Use the five registered downstream factors as a complete factorial schedule. Do not let return advantage, repairability, setback severity, switching cost, or option order co-vary with the target condition.
Counterbalance whether the established goal is narrated before or after the alternative, but keep the response mapping to option A explicit and identical across items.
Keep probe, behavior, steering, and calibration pools disjoint in domains, entities, and scenario events.
Calibration prompts must use abstract option A/option B tasks and contain none of the registered target-state or shortfall cues.
Do not use the construct ID, condition IDs, or labels such as continue or abandon in prompt_text.
Do not infer or alter the preregistered readout sign from generated prose.

behavior_factor_schedule.note: The five downstream factors are explicitly crossed. Generate one item per combination in the full schedule and preserve every field as structured metadata.
behavior_factor_schedule.balance_check: Each of the 80 combinations must appear exactly once per behavior and steering pool in the full inventory; review mode is a deliberately partial engineering sample.

downstream_pool_separation.note: The three downstream pools must use distinct concrete domains and semantic anchors; generic option-allocation syntax is allowed, but scenario topics and target-state wording are not shared.

cells.instructions: Generate the configured number of matched goal-renewal scenarios. Within each pair, duplicate the focal goal, recent shortfall, objective progress, resource cost, means status, revised implementation, current-plan facts, entities, sentence count, sentence order, and response framing; edit exactly one bounded goal-level recommendation clause. Do not rewrite rationale, alter means or plan facts, add an alternative outcome, or let any nuisance factor co-vary with the condition. Append the complete registered wrapper ending verbatim with `Continue processing the scenario.`.

Use new goals and shortfall types while preserving the exact one-clause focal-goal contrast. Within each pair, duplicate the shortfall, goal value, means viability, revised implementation, current-plan facts, and all surface nuisance factors; do not rewrite rationale or plan facts. Every prompt must use the complete registered wrapper and end with `Continue processing the scenario.`.

Use held-out domains and paraphrase families not used in train or validation. Within each pair, duplicate the shortfall, goal value, means viability, revised implementation, current-plan facts, and all surface nuisance factors; preserve exactly one bounded goal-level edit and do not add or remove plan/means consequences. Every prompt must be complete and end with `Continue processing the scenario.`.

Generate one independent adaptive-renewal allocation item per combination in behavior_factor_schedule.required_combinations (80 items). Use only public-water or regional-transit domains with concrete water, reservoir, irrigation, transit, bus, or rail anchors. Do not mention wildlife, habitat, wetland, conservation, coastal, marine, warehouse, museum, archive, or collection contexts in this pool. Use new actors, goals, domains, and resource types not present in probe prompts. Describe a recent underperformance of an established goal followed by a revised implementation; give explicit numerical expected net benefits for both options and an explicit switching cost. Do not ask about persistence or continuation. Record all five scheduled metadata fields exactly. Return exactly one integer from 0 to 100 for option A, and make the option-A mapping explicit even when the narrative order is alternative-first.

Generate one independent adaptive-renewal intervention item per combination in behavior_factor_schedule.required_combinations (80 items), distinct from behavior_eval. Use only wildlife-habitat or coastal-monitoring domains with concrete wildlife, habitat, wetland, conservation, coastal, or marine anchors. Describe a recent underperformance of an established goal followed by a revised implementation; give explicit numerical expected net benefits for both options and an explicit switching cost. Do not reuse behavior domains, probe entities, or ask about persistence. Record all five scheduled metadata fields exactly. Return exactly one integer from 0 to 100 for option A, with explicit option-A mapping under both narrative orders.

Generate neutral abstract allocation calibration items distinct from behavior and steering pools. Use only warehouse-inventory or museum-archive domains with concrete warehouse, inventory, stockroom, museum, archive, or collection anchors. Do not mention goals, persistence, continuation, abandonment, shortfalls, setbacks, switching costs, established programs, or revised implementations. Vary only the registered numerical option tradeoff, neutral task facts, and narrative option order. Return exactly one integer from 0 to 100 for option A and include the complete registered response request.
